title: Zesty Springy Japanese Pork Shoulder Gyudon
description: A fatty and adventurous Japanese dish featuring pork shoulder, served in a gyudon style, perfect for those looking for a low-carb meal option.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, and rice vinegar to make the marinade.
Add the sliced ginger to the marinade and stir to combine.
Place the pork shoulder in a pressure cooker and pour the marinade over it.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and set the valve to sealing.
Cook the pork shoulder on high pressure for 90 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Remove the pork shoulder from the pressure cooker and slice it into thin strips.
In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil and beef broth to make the sauce.
Add the sliced green onions to the sauce and stir to combine.
Serve the pork shoulder strips in a gyudon style, topped with the sauce and additional green onions if desired.
